info.desc: KISS THE RING is Rome Streetz’s debut studio album under the Griselda Records label. The entire album is executive produced by fellow rapper, Westside Gunn. The title of the record comes from a line off of “Feasting” off of Street Farmacy at the tail end of Rome’s verse; “Forever clean, I been shining, you never gleam Chasing treasure forever, know better, kiss the ring“ On May 18, 2022, during one of Griselda’s Claire’s Back shows in New York, Rome Streetz announced that his debut album would be coming soon.
